title: Choosing the Right Azure Region and Availability Zone
description: Select the optimal Azure region and availability zone for a global e-commerce application.

data.text: You are designing a global e-commerce platform that must serve customers in North America, Europe, and Asia. The application requires high availability, low latency, and compliance with GDPR and data residency laws. How do you choose Azure regions and availability zones?
**Choose regions close to your users** to minimize latency. Use **Availability Zones** within each region for high availability. Enable **geo-redundant storage** for disaster recovery across regions.

data.title: Azure CLI - List Available Regions
data.code:
az account list-locations --output table

# Filter for specific regions
az account list-locations --query "[?contains(displayName, 'Europe')]" --output table

data.title: ARM Template - Deploy with Availability Zone

data.text: Why Azure Regions and Availability Zones

Azure provides **60+ regions** worldwide, more than any other cloud provider. Each region has **3 Availability Zones** for 99.99% SLA. Azure's global backbone network ensures fast replication between regions.

cards.title: Azure Regions
cons: Some services not available in all regions

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: Use **Azure Traffic Manager** or **Front Door** for global load balancing across regions. Pair with **Cosmos DB** for multi-region data replication.
